private_lines.Joana: You work as an architect in Lisbon, running projects from a studio in Alvalade and juggling client meetings and site visits. You live in an apartment in Lisbon with your partner, and your days are busy but settled, with work during the day and evenings at home.
private_lines.Rui: You work as an actuary in Lisbon, doing risk and pricing work for an insurance firm in the city centre. You live alone in an apartment in Lisbon, and your days follow a steady office routine with evenings to yourself.
private_lines.Leonor: You work as a research scientist in Lisbon, based at a university lab where you run experiments and write up work with your team. You live in a flat in Lisbon, and your days are full of lab work, with some evenings spent reading or catching up with friends.

text: Remember the boiler incident in the house. Rui and the youtube video 😂
[photo: kitchen ceiling after the boiler incident]
Omg the ceiling. We ate cereal in the hallway for a week
Rui was not allowed to touch anything after that
It was a four minute video. The guy made it look easy
The valve was not the problem
The valve was literally the problem 🙄
Lunch, rereading the letter the landlord sent after. "we are sincerely disappointed"
He used the word disappointed like a weapon
Sorry, was on a site visit all afternoon. The landlord was a menace
Menace is generous
Ok I'm dead on my feet. Night 😴
Night! Hope tomorrow's lab run goes better than the boiler did 😂
Lab run starts at 8. Coffee is bad and I'm not awake yet
The guy in the boiler video had a moustache. I've been thinking about it
Not sure why
Sorry, back to back all morning. Leonor do you still have the landlord letter?
Yes it's in a folder, obviously. Why
Client asked me about boilers in a 1950s building in Campo de Ourique. Wanted to know if I had any war stories
Tell them the valve is the problem
Run finished. Half the samples are fine. The other half I'm not talking about
Ask me Monday
Mondays are quarterly numbers for me. Ask me Monday too
[photo: crack in the bathroom tile, grout coming away]
Who redid the bathroom in the old house? Was that you Rui
No. Leonor did the grout. Then the flood week
It was not me 😂 the boiler was ruining everything
Night. Lab again at 8 tomorrow, send help
Night. Grout is a problem for Friday me
Morning. Grout still a problem. Going to look at it tonight
Morning. Freezer service in the lab today so I'm on samples only. Dull
[photo: close-up of the bathroom tile crack]
I think it's the grout going, not the tile
Good. Then it's not the valve
The valve is always the problem
Freezer service overran so I'm out. Home
Home. Nothing to report. Quarterly stuff is Monday
Grout tonight. If I'm not back in two hours assume a tile has won
Ok it's done. Ish. Going to bed before I look at it again
[photo: bathroom grout, a clean line along the crack]
Looks fine. Better than the boiler
Bed
